discriminant.finding: The source-model reverse formation parameter returns the conjugate to the noncovalent F6P complex; donor C2x-C3x cleavage gives DHEThDP plus E4P. These are different exits from the conjugate.
discriminant.consequential_exclusion: Do not use E160Q k_reverse, F6P-ThDP accumulation, or the deposited scissile-bond length as an E160Q donor-cleavage rate.
discriminant.positive_content: Retrieve source-model state labels, exact existing E160Q parameters, accumulation observation and two distinct deposit bonds together.
discriminant.first_missing_premise: The retained kinetic scheme does not supply authenticated atom-resolved before states with the protonation, tautomerism and electron/proton changes needed for an elementary formation or cleavage step.

limitations: This source-model transition relation is not a complete elementary mechanism, atom-mapped reaction, observed trajectory or design template.

The Nature landing body is a subscription preview with accessible Data Availability and Extended Data legends. Full main text and Extended Data Figure1 image are not retained inputs to this increment.
Stopped-flow detects AP-band depletion; NMR supports the species assignment. A fitted formation parameter is not an independently isolated microscopic C-C bond-making rate.
The 4 C stopped-flow and 20 C, 30-second acid-quench NMR contexts are separate. Source equilibrium K2 is not calculated by combining their values or identified with k_forward/k_reverse.

Qualitative F6P-ThDP accumulation does not prove zero cleavage or a measured DHEThDP fraction. Acid-isolated DHEThDP is a conjugate acid in the source legend, not an unchanged solution carbanion-enamine.

Dictionary bonds and X-ray coordinates are distinct evidence. Original selected occupancies, 100 K measurement, crystal growth 277/279 K conflict and Ca/Mg alternate context remain; no occupancy-derived reactive fraction or chemical bond inferred from distance.
Exact assay construct sequences and physical preparations remain unresolved. The relation is source-reported-variant scoped.
No M0219 X5P/E4P map, X5P/R5P turnover substitution, productive F6P full cycle, cleavage rate, carbonyl bond-order change, proton accounting or evidence-tier promotion follows.
